r0_observed: PR #557 proposes a same-connection SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED diagnostic after OPEN_CONNECTION_PATH_REBIND counterevidence.
SQLite public documentation describes SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED as reporting whether the opened file has been renamed, moved or deleted since open.

SQLite Unix source fileHasMoved() checks the current pathname with stat() and compares its inode to the open file inode, which suggests a present-state discriminator rather than a durable movement history.
grf.hypothesis: SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED remains true after a move-away/move-back ABA of the exact same database object and can therefore attest movement history.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: On Unix, SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED only reflects whether the current path presently resolves to the opened inode; moving the same object away and back before the check returns false and erases the transient movement from this observation.
grf.falsifier: One disposable SQLite WAL connection; measure HAS_MOVED baseline, rename the main DB away and back to the identical pathname/object, then measure HAS_MOVED again on the same still-open connection and verify write/read continuity.
grf.predicted_if_counterhypothesis: baseline=0, after_ABA=0 with same inode and successful same-connection write/read
collapse: REJECT general inference: HAS_MOVED=0 proves the database pathname/object never moved since open.
RETAIN SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED as a useful same-connection current-state discriminator for a path that is presently moved/rebound.

DEFER any release claim requiring temporal continuity to a stronger deployment/operation boundary, external monotonic witness, immutable topology, or checks that make transient ABA impossible/observable.

unusual_experiment.intervention: Rename FRANK_UNIFIED.sqlite to a temporary away path and immediately rename the exact same file object back before the next SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED query.

primary_external_evidence.claim: SQLITE_FCNTL_HAS_MOVED reports whether the opened file has been renamed, moved or deleted.

primary_external_evidence.source: SQLite canonical Unix VFS source artifact
primary_external_evidence.claim: fileHasMoved() uses stat(pFile->zPath) and compares current pathname inode to the opened inode on Unix.
WAL-reset corruption bug affects versions through 3.51.2 and is fixed in 3.51.3 and later.
Current release 3.53.4 carries the WAL-reset fix; version suitability does not substitute for productive binding evidence.

frank_v0_1_impact.new_test_obligation: Do not let a point-in-time HAS_MOVED=0 receipt claim temporal no-move history. Accepted Hostinger product evidence must bind the real UnifiedDB operation/object across the measured critical interval and preserve restart/reopen, downgrade/library-swap/rollback and semantic-lineage controls.
frank_v0_1_impact.suggested_pr557_hardening: Add an ordinary regression for move-away/move-back ABA and narrow receipt wording from historical continuity to present path/object consistency unless another temporal invariant closes ABA.
